summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: Package @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-anvil2@9.0.2 is advertised as a chat UI library but ships an npm `preinstall` hook that runs an obfuscator.io-mangled `setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and uses it via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` to run a locally-shipped 727KB JavaScript file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (function `WV8StW` shifting an opaque constant array, hex-named identifiers, char-code-based string reconstruction) and carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header indicating it is intended for the downloaded Bun runtime rather than Node. This combination — preinstall lifecycle hook, obfuscated launcher, download and execution via a second runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection, and an obfuscated sibling payload — has no legitimate purpose in a UI library. The payload executes automatically on every `npm install` of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
